name: Asymmetric two columns
description: A two-thirds main column for a list or a paragraph, a one-third aside for one number or one sentence, and a thin rule between them. A 50/50 split would lose the balance of the main information taking more room and the blank space going to the secondary.

title.hint: a one-line claim, up to 24 characters

main.hint: main column: 3 to 5 items, or one paragraph

aside.hint: aside: one big number or one sentence

brand.value: Confirm the story before the slides

title.value: All tools: layout first, story later

items: Open the slide app and pick a template
Pour whatever comes to mind into the layout
Rehearse, find the order is wrong
